## Overview

This 2026-09-15-captured Adyen page is a Web integration **router** for PaySafeCard. It links separate Web Drop-in and Components method guides plus Sessions and Advanced base guides for both UIs. It does not itself define payment request fields, redirect processing, recurring behavior, or current merchant eligibility. See [[adyen]], [[adyen-online-payments]], and [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paysafecard]] for the method overview.

## Key takeaways

- Choose Web Drop-in for the all-in-one website UI or the Web Components child guide for the page's “Redirect” option. “Use the Redirect” is the router's wording; this page does not establish a precise SDK class name. Follow [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paysafecard-web-drop-in]] or [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paysafecard-web-component]] for method-specific instructions. See raw lines 19–27.
- Build the main Web integration before adding PaySafeCard. The page links Sessions and Advanced main guides for each UI. These links do not make their method-specific prerequisites or outcomes interchangeable. See raw lines 29–36.
